notes.title: Shibainu VR Katana Simulator Development Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41895700/fa143ccf615d5a78ee3690ef9079cf673f8c423c.png[/img]

Hello everyone,

I wanted to give you all an update on the development of Shibainu. I know many of you have been waiting for more updates, and I apologize for the delays.

I am happy to report that the work is well underway and making great progress. One of the main goals for the next update is the port to Unreal Engine 5. However, the process is taking longer than I initially anticipated.

But I assure you, the wait will be worth it! The new Unreal Engine 5 will bring some exciting new features to the game. Some of the highlights include advanced procedural cuts, optimization in several systems, a wider variety of targets to challenge your skills, and new game modes to keep things fresh and interesting.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41895700/873eb1568e0c42a627d4c04f7e9d8724ec8fedea.gif[/img]

You can see the development roadmap (with estimated dates) in the following link: https://github.com/users/HernanOlave/projects/4/views/3

For the latest news, join the discord channel: https://discord.com/invite/SUDkgEMTtJ

I am excited about these new features and can't wait for you to try them out. I will continue to keep you updated on the progress and will let you know as soon as the update is ready for release.

Thank you for your patience and continued support.

Best regards, 
Volrath

notes.title: Early Access Release date Changed: July 11.
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41895700/b3de4c899b8cda5fa4bd21755c769b58c3c3b8e0.png[/img]

Hello there everyone!

The early access release of Shibainu VR Katana Simulator has moved from June 27th to July 11th.

This was primarily due to an overlapping schedule with the steam summer sale; which would have negatively impacted the game's visibility (game releases doesn’t get promoted during this period).

We will use these two weeks to polish the build and QA; while trying to add some features that should help with performance. And in the meantime, we are releasing an updated version of the FREE demo, which will be available from June 28th until July 3rd.

We thank you all for your patience and support!

notes.title: ⚔️ Shibainu VR Katana Simulator - Live stream with the Devs
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41895700/b8609b1030768fc652925325968393e72f8045e4.png[/img]

Game director Hernan "Volrath" Olave and Programmer Felipe Molina come together for the live stream on [b]Jun 14th 1PM PDT[/b] to showcase gameplay, talk about new features and Q&A with Chat.

In the demo, you will be able to play 3 of the 10 levels from the Dojo map, use both Katana and Wakizashi Swords, playtest physics and mechanics. The demo is available during Next Game Fest till Jun 20th.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1877780/Shibainu__VR_Katana_Simulator/
ShibaInu is a virtual reality (VR) Katana simulator. This game mainly focuses on proper Katana handling, physics interactions and cutting mechanics. Precise and controlled cuts are performed on Tatamis (traditional Japanese floor mat) rolled into a cylindrical shape.
